svg.title: Shared and private targets
svg.desc: A shared target is visible to and usable by everyone. A private target is visible to and usable only by the user who made it, and anything built on it is private too. Credentials are whatever the target is configured with and never decide visibility. Every target reports whether the provider rejected its credentials on the last request.
svg.text: Visibility is a choice made when the target is created. It never depends on the credentials.
Everyone sees it and can use it.
Configured on the server, or created in the
GUI or API with "Only me" off.
Only its creator sees it and can use it.
For anyone else it doesn't exist.
Anything built on it (a scorer, round robin,
Credentials either way: whatever the target is configured with (a key, headers, the server's identity, or none).
Every target shows whether the provider accepted them on the last request: key = accepted, lock = rejected.
